app.name: E-Commerce Store
app.description: Modern e-commerce platform with product catalog, cart, checkout, and order management

requirements.description: Full-featured e-commerce store with beautiful product displays, smooth checkout, and comprehensive admin panel
features: Product catalog with categories and filters

screens.name: Home
screens.description: Stunning homepage with hero banner, featured products, categories, new arrivals, and newsletter signup

screens.name: Product Listing
screens.description: Product grid with filters (category, price, brand), sort options, and pagination

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.description: Product page with image gallery, variants, add to cart, reviews, and related products

screens.name: Category
screens.description: Category page with subcategories and filtered products

screens.name: Cart
screens.description: Shopping cart with quantity controls, remove items, and order summary

screens.name: Checkout
screens.description: Multi-step checkout with shipping, payment, and review steps

screens.name: Order Confirmation
screens.description: Order confirmation with details and tracking link

screens.name: Account
screens.description: Customer account with orders, addresses, and profile settings

screens.name: Wishlist
screens.description: Saved items with add to cart functionality

screens.name: Search
screens.description: Search results page with filters and suggestions

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.description: Admin panel with orders, products, customers, and analytics

screens.name: Admin Products
screens.description: Product management with CRUD operations and bulk actions

screens.name: Admin Orders
screens.description: Order management with status updates and fulfillment
